inference_unit: participant after within-participant averaging across seeds
multiplicity: Holm within each baseline x context x metric family; six candidate comparisons per family

A0.definition: Frozen source Global Fusion; no target-personalization residual.

A1.definition: Direct attentive Neural Process probability without a frozen Global anchor. The bounded residual, contrast-direction safety rule, source gamma activation, and exact Global fallback are consequently not applicable.
A1.role: broader unanchored architectural comparator, not a one-factor ablation

A2.definition: Frozen Global anchor plus contrast-direction residual, with no hard residual bound and gamma fixed to 1.

A3.definition: Frozen Global anchor plus bounded residual, but residual direction is learned freely rather than constrained by query contrast; gamma fixed to 1.

A4.definition: Frozen Global anchor plus bounded, contrast-direction residual with gamma=1.
A4.role: full constrained residual before source strength selection

A5.definition: A4 with gamma selected on source-only validation episodes, before applying the minimum NLL-improvement activation threshold.

A6.definition: A5 plus the prespecified minimum source-NLL improvement threshold and exact gamma=0 fallback to the frozen Global probability.

interpretation_limits.A1: A1 is not a single-parameter anchor-removal ablation. It is a broader direct/unanchored NP architectural comparator for which the bounded residual, direction rule, source-gamma activation and exact fallback are not applicable. Do not attribute A1-vs-A6 differences solely to the frozen anchor.
